prepared_cases: Actual Project editor creates native membership and materialized source; saved native Projects rule permits the signer in a new authenticated verification request.
Actual native membership removal denies a new verification request and mail source lookup; re-add is a genuine positive control.
Actual named policy resolves to the native rule; changing its effective policy to no-one denies a new request and mail source lookup; restoring it permits a new request.
Independent PHP verifier waits on the actual signature row lock; the owning setup transaction rotates the real secret and commits; stale consumption is refused, current-secret GET remains valid.

Independent PHP verifier waits on the actual document row lock; the owning setup transaction advances the real document version and commits; old-version consumption is refused and the new request also rejects that stale signature.

native_semantics.project_membership: Retained native ProjectTransactionEditor plus actual materialized member edge, not a caller authorization boolean or synthetic policy evaluator.
native_semantics.project_candidate_model: Disabled only in the isolated membership setup scope; document authorization still uses the actual viewer native query and native rule.
native_semantics.named_policy: Actual native saved named/effective policy rows queried by the document policy engine.
native_semantics.document_space: LegalpadDocument does not implement SpacesInterface. No document Space ACL is added or claimed.
native_semantics.freshness: Each verification request and final verifier permission check has a private fresh request cache and actual viewer document query. Project/named dependencies are not all locked by the verifier.
native_semantics.atomicity_limit: These cases prove only their observed timing profiles. They do not prove global atomic revocation between the final VIEW read and COMMIT. The accepted native request boundary is retained; no stronger permission model is introduced.

concurrency_proof_required: Independent exec-created PHP process with genuine native web session, native CSRF and unchanged verifier.
Actual worker SQL and performance_schema lock wait identify the exact held signature/document table and setup connection before mutation.
Only exact PhorgeLegalpadVerificationException is mapped to the fixed expected refusal; arbitrary SQL/type/source exceptions remain failed.
Signature remains unverified and stored actor/contact data unchanged; every process and private file is cleaned and temporary source mutations restored.
not_proved: Supported PHP/MySQL execution of these six cases
Revocation after the last VIEW read but before COMMIT
All transitive or plugin policy source atomic closure
Latest-main integration, Legalpad SMTP, trusted browser acceptance or production activation
Verifier-victim deadlock rollback, actual controller500 and released-lock/no-follow-up-mail evidence

observed_deadlock_boundary.observed_cycle: Verifier holds secretKey and waits PRIMARY; competing source writer holds PRIMARY and waits secretKey.
observed_deadlock_boundary.observed_victim: Source-rotation setup transaction, not the verifier.
observed_deadlock_boundary.signature_state_after_victim_selection: Not captured before fixture cleanup; no unverified or denial claim is made.
observed_deadlock_boundary.deterministic_stale_source_fixture: Parent now acquires the verifier secretKey-first order, solely to test stale-source rechecking.
observed_deadlock_boundary.remaining_acceptance: A separate verifier-victim test must prove rollback, released locks, native controller infrastructure error and no follow-up mail; do not swallow1213 or retry consumption as permission denial.
